designed.shape_derivative_boundary: 0 (volume formulation used; no separate boundary expression required)
designed.shape_derivative_boundary_rationale: Topology optimization evolves interior interfaces; the extracted Hadamard expression is already volumetric and is used directly for the level-set transport equation.

boundaries.name: \Gamma_3
boundaries.rationale: Mesh label 3 inferred from the subscript \Gamma_3.

boundaries.name: \Gamma_N
boundaries.description: remaining boundary with homogeneous natural (insulated) condition
boundaries.rationale: The weak form contains no boundary integral, so the rest of \partial D is assigned a natural Neumann condition.

fields.name: u
fields.rationale: Scalar temperature discretised with P2; kelvin inferred from the thermal constants; Dirichlet label mapped to \Gamma_3.

fields.name: u_tilde
fields.rationale: Adjoint temperature variable; shares the state finite-element space and Dirichlet conditions.

expressions.name: phi
expressions.rationale: Initial signed-distance level-set function for a sphere of radius 0.25 centred in the unit cube; updated during optimisation.

expressions.name: Lagrangian
expressions.formula: J(u) - \int_D f \delta u \, dx + \int_D \lambda \chi (\nabla u \cdot \nabla \delta u) \, dx

expressions.name: heat_flux
expressions.rationale: Standard derived heat-flux quantity used for post-processing and physical interpretation.

characteristic_function.rationale: Contrast 1/10 penalises void conductivity and is consistent with the extracted chi formula.

optimization_config.rationale: Assumes a unit-cube design domain; hmin/hmax are about 1/100 and 1/10 of the domain size, level-set diffusion is 1e-4, CFL velocity is 1e-2, 30 iterations are used, and the initial design is a centred sphere. Boundary label 1 is the natural Neumann rest boundary and label 3 is the fixed Dirichlet boundary.
